description: This file is a shell script used in the OpenWrt/LEDE project, containing functions for platform-specific checks, upgrades, and configuration copying related to different hardware boards.

methods.name: platform_check_image
methods.description: Checks the integrity or suitability of the firmware image for specific boards.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade
methods.description: Performs hardware-specific upgrade procedures based on the board type.

methods.name: platform_copy_config
methods.description: Copies configuration to the board based on its type.
